item.description:
Sign updates with --ed-key-file so CI can sign at all

sign_update's second positional argument is a signature to verify, not a key
file, so `sign_update <dmg> <keyfile>` quietly ignored the file and signed with
the Keychain. That works on a development machine and can never work on a
runner, which has no Keychain entry — the release job failed there with no
output. Pass --ed-key-file explicitly, and check the key and tool up front.
